Name: Sam_Girl Dialogue change
Author: KeionDryke
Description:
Made this to go with Adarin's Sam_Girl mod http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/412/?

[size=4][u]INSTALLATION
[/u][/size]Place the folder in the Content Folder in your Stardew Valley directory
Let if overwrite any files it asks
Don't forget to back up the originals

This mod is not compatible with other mods that change dialog.
Adarin has stated he will make one package for all the Girl mods once he finishes them. I will do the same for the dialogue changes. Until then, I can make a patch between 2 of them if it's requested.

If you see any errors, please let me know and I'll get them fixed ASAP.
Keep in mind certain things can't be fixed yet like doors before getting 2 hearts.

Downloads.Description: A patch so the dialogue changes for Elliot, Sam and Alex all work together as requested by a downloader.
